upstream.validity_filter: east_valid==1 and west_valid==1; finite nonnegative central rates
upstream.proton_rate_5min_sha256_provenance: canonical LF bytes of pinned Git blob 5de108c6759bcf720073b3fbc6581389d46e63aa; exact bytes emitted by git show
upstream.historical_crlf_sha256_note: historical CRLF serialization only; not accepted by the exact Git-blob reproduction gate

memory.organization: declared post-W data-only: 2^19 logical words x 32 data bits

model.rho_semantics: fraction of total erroneous-bit intensity allocated to same-word two-bit parent events; not a parent-event probability

scenario.boundary_state: carry through t=300; no free reset

restoration.word_reset_offset: (w+1)*P/N_words from pass start; credit at end of 4-address group

certificate.classification: certified iff exact Q <= epsilon; direct strict-exhaustion iff Lambda_D > epsilon

selection_rule: minimize worst-case total pass count across LL,LH,HL,HH
lexicographically minimize path pass-count vector in LL,LH,HL,HH order
lexicographically maximize realized periods in path/time order
